description: Run an SEO audit on a URL. Crawls the primary page plus up to 8 priority secondary pages, checks technical / content / crawlability / structured-data / local / social-sharing categories, and returns scored checks, per-page issues, keyword gaps, and prioritized recommendations. AEO (AI-visibility) data is intentionally NOT bundled — call jackpotkeywords_aeo_scan for that. Costs $0.50 per audit (50¢). Refunded automatically on failure. Latency ~20–60 seconds.

url.description: URL to audit (e.g., https://yourproduct.com or yourproduct.com). Required.

name: jackpotkeywords_audit
